query_data_server.description: Run a query against the compatibility layer for the retired Text Data Server. Its one advantage over the other actions is an explicit start and end time, so it can pull a past window of METARs, TAFs, pilot reports, SIGMETs, or G-AIRMETs rather than only recent ones. Give a start and end time for that; with neither, it reads the last two hours. Answers in XML or CSV, returned in 'content'.

query_data_server.name: query_data_server

parameters.description: Which product to query.
parameters.name: dataSource

parameters.description: Station IDs to query, separated by commas. Give this, a bounding box, or a radial distance.
parameters.name: stationString

parameters.description: Bounding box to search, as lat0, lon0, lat1, lon1: the south-west corner followed by the north-east corner. Longitudes in the Americas are negative.
parameters.name: boundingBox

parameters.description: Beginning of the window to query, as yyyymmdd_hhmm or an ISO 8601 timestamp. Give this together with an end time to pull a specific past window; leave both blank to use 'Hours back' instead.
parameters.name: startTime

parameters.description: End of the window to query, as yyyymmdd_hhmm or an ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: endTime

parameters.description: Query the last this many hours. Defaults to 2. A start and end time take precedence over this if you give them, so leave those blank to use it.
parameters.name: hoursBeforeNow

parameters.description: Output format. Defaults to XML; TAFs are not available as CSV. Either way the document is returned in 'content'.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Return only the latest report for each station, for METARs and TAFs. 'Constraint' asks the server for the newest report directly; 'post-filter' fetches the window and then thins it, which is slower but honours the other filters.
parameters.name: mostRecentForEachStation

parameters.description: Circular bounds for pilot reports, in the legacy server's own spelling: distance in statute miles, a semicolon, then longitude and latitude.
parameters.name: radialDistance

content.description: The response verbatim for the raw, decoded, XML, IWXXM, CSV, and plain-text formats. Empty for JSON and GeoJSON.

count.description: Number of rows in 'entries'; 0 when a text format was asked for

entries.description: One row per product for the JSON and GeoJSON formats (GeoJSON rows are features, each with its own geometry). Empty for every other format.

items.description: One decoded product, whose fields depend on the product this action reads

format.description: The format the products were requested in

description: Read official US aviation weather from the National Weather Service's Aviation Weather Center, through its keyless public Data API: METARs and TAFs, pilot reports, SIGMETs and AIRMETs, center advisories, the convective forecast, winds and temperatures aloft, area forecasts and forecast discussions, plus airport, station, navaid, fix, and obstacle lookups. No account or API key required.
